name: @conductor/diary
description: Local, per-machine append-only diary (docs/adr/0007-fase6-diary-and-capture.md D1-D8): entries.jsonl as the source of truth, a derived node:sqlite index for recall/search, curateCaptureEvent for minimized-at-the-source automatic capture, and renderDigest as the only workspace-facing artifact. Imports ONLY the PURE retrieval primitives of @conductor/library (D3 -- never its I/O edge modules); zero @conductor/runtime dependency (the diary/runtime coupling is the two surgical deltas in gate-evidence.ts/redaction.ts/workspace-policy.ts, owned by @conductor/runtime itself, not by this package).
